task_instance: Scaffold a minimal Azure Logic Apps Standard project locally and validate it offline using the az logicapp extension: 'az logicapp project create --path App --workflow Orders' followed by 'az logicapp workflow validate --path App --workflow Orders' (the skill's core local authoring/validation deliverable).
blocker_detail: The skill's entire interface is the 'logicapp' Azure CLI preview extension (version 1.0.0b1), which provides the 'project create', 'workflow create', and 'workflow validate' commands. Installing it requires fetching the official Azure CLI extension index, but the outbound request to that index is blocked by the agent proxy (tunnel refused, 403 Forbidden), so 'az extension add --name logicapp --version 1.0.0b1 --allow-preview true' fails with 'Unable to get extension index'. The built-in 'az logicapp' command group shipped with azure-cli core only manages already-deployed logic apps (create/delete/list/scale/start/stop/update plus config and deployment subgroups); it has no 'project' or 'workflow' subcommands, so the local scaffolding/validation deliverable cannot be exercised without the extension. I did not substitute a private wheel or any other source, per the skill's and the run's rules.
evidence: Created venv at <work>/.venv and 'pip install azure-cli' succeeded; 'az version' reports azure-cli 2.91.0 (meets the >=2.67.0 requirement). With AZURE_CONFIG_DIR pointed inside the work dir, 'az extension add --name logicapp --version 1.0.0b1 --allow-preview true' returned: 'ERROR: Unable to get extension index... Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden' against the Azure extension index host. 'az extension list -o json' returns []. 'az logicapp --help' shows only core commands (config, deployment, create, delete, list, restart, scale, show, start, stop, update) and 'az logicapp project create --path App --workflow Orders' returns "'project' is misspelled or not recognized by the system." No workflow was scaffolded or validated. Files: <work>/.venv (azure-cli core only), <work>/.azure (empty extension dir).
